summary: Full backend + frontend testing of LearnForge Opportunity Radar. 11/11 pytest cases passed covering GET/POST/PUT/DELETE on /api/signals, /api/signals/stats, 404 handling, conversion engine updates (with slug derivation), syllabus generation (5 modules, status bump tracked->converting). Frontend E2E verified via Playwright: dashboard header, 4 stat cards, signal table with 7 seeded rows sorted desc by priority, Convert button opens right-side Sheet with all conversion engine inputs, CTA preview banner with Enroll/Free buttons, Trigger Syllabus generates and renders 5 modules under '04 · Generated Syllabus', Log Signal dialog creates a new row that appears in table, Edit (pencil) opens dialog with prefilled values, Delete (trash) removes row. All data-testids resolved correctly.

integration_issues.issue: Clipboard write fails in some browser contexts (toast shows 'Copy failed'). Buttons are clickable and wired, but navigator.clipboard.writeText() can fail in non-secure/iframe contexts. Consider a textarea+execCommand fallback or document.execCommand('copy') fallback.

issues: Radix DialogContent emits a11y warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined}'. Add <DialogDescription> or aria-describedby to silence and improve a11y.

action_items: (Optional) Add clipboard fallback for cta-copy-free-btn / cta-copy-paid-btn so copy works in restricted browser contexts.
(Optional) Add DialogDescription or aria-describedby to DialogContent in SignalFormDialog and ConversionPanel Sheet to remove Radix a11y warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 381 lines - still acceptable but consider splitting models/routes if it grows.
Syllabus generator is intentionally simulated per spec - clearly named generate_syllabus, OK.
MongoDB _id is properly excluded everywhere via projection {'_id': 0} and doc.pop('_id', None).
All endpoints use proper HTTPException with 404 status codes.
Pydantic validation in place via SignalCreate/SignalUpdate.
Backend CORS allows '*' which is fine for this internal tool.
Slug derivation correctly invoked on create and update.
Auto-seed on startup is idempotent (checks count first).
test_credentials: N/A - no auth in this app
seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seeds 7 signals on startup. Tests create TEST_-prefixed signals and clean them up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_signals.py covers all 7 endpoints + CRUD flow. Frontend testids in /app/frontend/src/constants/testIds/dashboard.js. Convert button opens right-side Sheet (Radix). The two clipboard-copy buttons may fail in headless contexts due to clipboard API restrictions - this is expected, not a code bug.
rca of the issue: No critical issues. Two minor enhancements suggested: (1) clipboard fallback for copy buttons, (2) DialogDescription for a11y.
